answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 30939 Country: India Title: how shd the dress of a muslimah be? how was the clothing of the pure wives & daughters of our beloved nabi (pbuh)? was is like salwaar kameez? Question: how shd the dress of a muslimah be? how was the clothing of the pure wives & daughters of our beloved nabi (pbuh)? was is like salwaar kameez? please give detailed desciption. Answer ID: 30939 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 469/392/B=1432) The words of Qamis, Izar and Rida (Chuddar) is mentioned in hadith, its details are not found in any authentic hadith. However, it is mentioned that one should not follow the national or religious signs of other people and their styles should not be adopted. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
